references.text: The tribe of Judah and their leader, Nahshon son of Amminadab, are placed first in the camp, which explains why they also break camp first during the march.
Nahshon son of Amminadab is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Judah at the census.
Nahshon son of Amminadab from the tribe of Judah was the first to bring his offering at the dedication of the altar.
Amminadab is mentioned as the father of Nahshon in Aaron's genealogy.
Amminadab and Nahshon are mentioned in Perez's genealogy, showing Judah's royal line.
Nahshon son of Amminadab is mentioned as the prince over the children of Judah in Judah's genealogical record.
Amminadab and Nahshon are mentioned in Jesus' genealogy, showing the connection to the tribe of Judah.
Amminadab and Nahshon are mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus.
